DOM/web-UI swaps — no DOM, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, lucide-react, or old web UI imports: PageContainer (title/subtitle/actions + query freshness; no loading/empty prop so children always render) -> an inline scaffold (persistent header + always-rendered body); usePageTitle -> the same translated string surfaced as an accessibilityRole='header' on-screen page title (no document.title on native); GlassPanel -> native GlassPanel; Select (vehicle picker) -> a segmented radio pill group (accessibilityRole='radiogroup'/'radio', the established native single-choice control) preserving the placeholder + {value,label} options and the value/onChange contract exactly; PanelTitle + lucide Activity -> SemanticIcon name='activity' + bold AppText; EmptyState lucide Radio -> the shared native EmptyState preceded by a decorative SemanticIcon name='radio'; SectionErrorBoundary -> an inline SectionBoundary error-boundary class (getDerivedStateFromError) with a warning-iconed inline fallback; LiveIndicator variant='compact' -> the shared native LiveIndicator; query={live} (DataFreshnessAuto) -> the shared native FreshnessIndicator driven by live.dataUpdatedAt (rendered once the query has data, which — like the web disabled-query badge — only occurs after a vehicle is selected); FadeIn (framer-motion) -> a plain View; DataTable + Input + useSortToggle (web LiveSignalsTable) -> a native search TextInput (onChange e.target.value -> onChangeText) with a leading SemanticIcon name='search', tappable sortable Signal/Last-update headers showing ↑/↓, and a card list of rows; TimeStamp value=row.timestamp format='relative' -> formatRelative inlined faithfully from @/lib/dateFormat.formatRelative (just now / Nm / Nh / Nd ago, absolute >7d via the inlined formatDate, '—' for nullish/invalid); the font-mono name/value cells -> Platform.select Menlo/monospace styles; Tailwind text-[var(--text-*)] colours -> theme tokens (textPrimary/textMuted/textSecondary/accent). DataTable pagination (defaultPageSize 50) is intentionally omitted — the full sorted list renders inside the page ScrollView, preserving all data.
